description: The 'Task Context' bundle interpolated into agents/prompts/*.md for each run. Kept intentionally small: the agent gets only what it needs plus repository access to investigate further.

objective.description: Task description, used as the objective/acceptance criteria.

stack.description: e.g. 'React + Laravel', derived from the project's frontend/backend/database fields.

last_result.description: Summary of the most recent agent_executions row for this task, if any.
